Bug_Title: NP: Store of null value into field annotated @Nonnull (NP_STORE_INTO_NONNULL_FIELD)
Bug_Details: A value that could be null is stored into a field that has been annotated as @Nonnull.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is caused by the code trying to store a null value into a field annotated with @Nonnull. The code first initializes the field to be null and then tries to store a null value into it, which is not allowed by the annotation.
